name: EmployNV Youth Hub at West Charleston Library
what_you_do: Get help with jobs, paid training, internships, pre-apprenticeships and mentoring from career coaches. Free to join.
who_can_apply: Teens and young adults ages 16 to 24, in school or out of school. The page lists no other rules.
pay_detail: Services are free. Paid training and internships are offered; pay not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Hub open Monday to Friday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.
how_to_apply: Call 702.602.5199 or visit EmployNVYouthHub.org. The hub is at West Charleston Library, 6301 W. Charleston Blvd.
notes: Teens 16 and up only. The next-door Teen Zone is a separate space for ages 12 to 18.
